faqs.question: What is this website?
faqs.answer: This is an AI-powered real estate price prediction platform.

faqs.question: How does price prediction work?
faqs.answer: The system predicts property prices using factors such as location, area, bedrooms, floor, furnishing, property age and other property characteristics.

faqs.question: How do I predict a property price?
faqs.answer: Open the Prediction page, enter the property details and submit the form to receive the estimated price.

faqs.question: Which locations are supported?
faqs.answer: The available locations are based on the property dataset used by the application.
